name: Thurgauer Kantonalbank
summary: Thurgauer Kantonalbank provides various banking products and services in Switzerland. It offers accounts; cards; mobile and instant payments, terminals, and QR invoice; mortgages and loans, including building and renovating, real estate pension, and property valuation; asset management; saving with securities; investments in securities, precious metals, and cryptocurrencies; services packages; construction financing; business loans; fixed advance; capital good leasing; trade finance; foreign exchange; and digital banking.
